nodes.label: Module stylesheet scoping and tv- prefix
nodes.rationale: Every rule is scoped under .module-tori-valley and every class prefixed tv-, because the two stylesheets name tokens alike with different values (--color-primary Torī red vs Catppuccin mauve, --space-5 24px vs 20px, --radius-lg 16px vs 14px) and element selectors would have restyled the whole app for the rest of the session — a stylesheet is not unloaded on navigation. The prefix guards the other direction: Scoreo's theme.css styles plain .card and .empty, and reusing the name shipped a real layout bug (#349). check-module-styles.mjs fails on either breach.

nodes.label: No storage, no port, no adapter
nodes.rationale: The ports, adapters, use cases and DI container went with the standalone shell (#330, #350): a module owns no storage, so it has nothing to abstract. Everything persisted goes through ModuleHost, stored by Scoreo under its own keys.

nodes.label: Strictly inward dependency direction
nodes.rationale: ui → domain, and domain imports from nothing else — including no i18n dependency: domain errors carry a plain string code that the ui layer translates.

nodes.label: Zod .default() backward-compat rule
nodes.rationale: Adding a field to a persisted model must give it a zod .default() so data written by an older app version keeps loading; schemas parse on read and fail open (unparseable JSON → empty result) rather than throwing.

nodes.label: Visual regression suite lives in the host
nodes.rationale: jsdom computes no layout, so behaviour tests can assert what the DOM says but never what the user sees. Playwright screenshots moved to the host with the shell because that is Scoreo's route, where players actually meet the module; the two suites never overlap.
